industry.why: Neutral, carried, balanced on new evidence both ways. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): two houses call a cyclical upturn, DNB Carnegie (22 Oct) reading Sandvik and Metso as a new mining cycle and Danske (18 Oct) heavy trucks and pulp and paper turning, and Goldman's economists (16 Oct) have US industrial production beating with machinery and electrical equipment near peak capacity use; against it, Danske's own warning that most cyclical exposure is 'more or less at all-time highs' with 'cost inflation emerging', a risk-off regime confirmed on all five defensive windows, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, C prior at industry level. The sector rows do the work: Electrical equipment and grid, Diversified groups, Distributors and Test and measurement at C, Flow control and Building technology at D. Counter-case for B: the order data are the strongest non-AI demand read in the pack; for D: the tape and the regime.

sector.why: Underweight. Component 1 regime (rates-led late cycle: Richard's view 16-Sep-26, rates and yields rising, inflation high, consumer confidence low, downside skew; sources absent): discretionary industrial capex is deferred first when rates rise and recession risk grows. Relative strength AGREES, D both readings. Counter-case: 21 stocks, order books lag.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged on this week's reading. Goldman Sachs (16 Oct) has French spreads at decade highs with tentative spillover to Italy and judges France's fiscal challenge 'harder now than in 2011-15'; the premium in basis points was not read, so the reversal conditions (back to D under 120 basis points, to C under 100) could not be tested and are plainly not met at a decade high. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country; no live holding is French-listed. Counter-case unchanged: a country letter is a blunt tool on 110 stocks and lands on French-listed global businesses (TotalEnergies, whose memo exposures lift its Thematic Fit/Momentum by two grades through the stock layer; Soitec; Sopra Steria; Alten) as hard as on domestic banks and property; and Goldman's own judgement is that disorderly escalation is less likely than in 2011-15.
